title: Mixed Tate motives over number fields
summary: This paper relates algebraic K-theory of fields to polylogarithms via general linear groups. We focus on the case of number fields and prove that the motivic realisation map from the Goncharov Lie coalgebra to the motivic Lie coalgebra is an isomorphism. This implies the Goncharov universality conjecture and a structural result for special values of Dedekind zeta functions. We also construct explicit polylogarithmic cocycles representing nonzero multiples of the Borel classes.
